instruction: Pick the white bottle for storing items and put it onto the pad

source.instruction: Pick the white bottle for storing items and put it onto the pad

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the pillbottle, which was at x = +15 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.plan: Move right gripper to (16, -8, 94), point down, and rotate yaw to align with the bottle.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-15, +11, -0) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the pillbottle
